It advertises a Mali/GPU compatibility build and its own device report, but adds no distinct game or platform target; preserve as lineage/compatibility evidence rather than creating a duplicate game-port row.
A reusable PS Vita porting agent-skill/toolkit rather than a finished game or application port; out of the game-project catalog scope.

The README describes iOS preservation ports of a game originally designed for iOS, not PC/console-to-phone or phone-to-console work. The project’s binary/data/runtime provenance and license scope are not sufficiently clear for this mobile-port lane.
Already cataloged as sonic-r-android-decomp-port. The exact repository, Android target, status, and language evidence were checked; do not add a second row.
Already cataloged as skate3-ios-recomp. It appeared in a prior staged/approved addition manifest and in the live catalog; no duplicate addition.

This proposed Android row shares the exact Burnout 3 Original Xbox → Android game/platform tuple with existing Takedawn and is derived from sp00nznet/burnout3. It is retained as a distinct Android-specific implementation because its README documents its own SDL2 app, Vulkan/NV2A renderer and device matrix, but the overlap must remain explicit and popularity must not be double-counted as an independent game target.

The README describes loading an Android ARM32 game binary on Windows/Linux/macOS using a CPU JIT plus native Android-API reimplementations; it is a desktop compatibility project, not a phone/console port for this mobile lane. It may merit a separate desktop/API-translation review.
A cross-platform game engine/template with Android and Switch homebrew targets, not a specific legacy game decompilation, recompilation, or port target.

A general Android-to-PS-Vita .so loader/boilerplate and porting technique. It is a framework rather than one game-specific port; catalog separately only if the project list is expanded to reusable tools.
A very small fork/duplicate search hit for the already-cataloged Need for Speed Most Wanted PC-to-Android recompilation repository codepdbh/nfsmwpc-recompiled; do not create a second target row.
